title: HiddenTables & PyQTax: A Cooperative Game and Dataset For TableQA to Ensure Scale and Data Privacy Across a Myriad of Taxonomies
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical framework and dataset (PyQTax) for evaluating Large Language Models on table question-answering tasks with a focus on privacy and efficiency. It contains no components evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
